limits: Static helper/plan-record-verb membership and policy validity only; not flags, ordering, live execution, or semantic verification of approved equivalents. Control mirrors are owned source fixtures, not evidence that the actual generator ran; tests/test_driver_parity.py builds the real flow-auto mirror. The three delegated Codex mirrors intentionally do not exist. The constructed anchor uses a fixed legacy helper list and trusts waiver metadata.
